name: XY Labs, Inc.
summary: XY Labs, Inc. specializes in the development of geolocation hardware and software, alongside complementary online platforms for data management and integration. Its extensive portfolio includes consumer products and applications, enterprise Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions, and advanced blockchain and cryptographic technologies and services. Key offerings include the XY4+, a Bluetooth item finder renowned for its exceptional range, loud alarm, and extended battery life; and the XYO Network, a blockchain-powered system designed for housing geospatial information. The company also provides the COIN mobile application, which allows users to acquire digital assets by validating geospatial location data while traveling, commuting, jogging, or moving. Established in San Diego, California, in 2012, the firm rebranded from XY – The Persistent Company to XY Labs, Inc. in May 2021. Operating under the XYO brand, the company leverages an incentive-driven blockchain network, supported by over 3 million IoT devices, to anonymously gather and verify geospatial data.
